creation_order_safety.why: New append-only journal tags must remain creatable during Runtime and the activation tag must be creatable exactly once; deletion/update/non-fast-forward protection applies after each matching ref exists.

future_provisioning_algorithm: Fresh Read canonical main and exact Stage1 canonical code/authority bindings.
Fresh Read repository tag-ruleset state through an approved GitHub administration channel.
If an existing ruleset exactly satisfies the reviewed spec, do not create a duplicate; Fresh Read its detail and bind its immutable observed id and updated_at as the Phase B result.
Otherwise create exactly one repository tag ruleset matching the reviewed spec. Do not add bypass actors, exclusions, a creation rule, extra includes, extra rule types, or other conditions.
Fresh Read the resulting ruleset detail from GitHub and require exact semantic equality with the reviewed spec.
Require the canonical Runtime-CAS strict-journal predicate and activation-loader strict-ruleset predicate to accept the Fresh Read detail.
Record only ruleset id, updated_at, exact reviewed spec identity, and non-secret verification facts for later activation-receipt preparation.
Do not provision the writer key, Runtime branch, sequence-0 ledger, activation tag, runtime state, or execute any task in Phase B.

scope.purpose: Freeze and independently review the exact production tag-ruleset specification and the guarded provisioning procedure.
